digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions bridge workflows and core push delivery
propositions: Both reconcile-bridge and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows must delegate git operations to core push entrypoints with exactly one synchronous push action per workflow and no inline CAS loops
Strict workflow delivery must remain synchronous and exit red on exhausted delivery failure while core owns retry and CAS recovery logic
Reconciler workflow must preserve exact bot identity and commit subject while pushing dirty tracker state despite sync.push=off via REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always override
Raw-git exemption must be removed from reconciler and synthetic CAS-loop rationale from test fixtures, with standing-decision blocks documenting core-owned delivery
Python library and MCP push operations retain best-effort semantics; only CLI workflow adapters enforce strict synchronous delivery
Canary workflow must execute a push-only strict action without inline fetch/merge/retry and keep pending commits on policy rejection
